steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Order. Each risk is placed by its review date.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

findings.title: Review date has passed
findings.fix: Review the risk and set the next date

findings.title: Action with no owner
findings.fix: Assign an owner to the action

findings.title: Rating does not match the exposure

outcome.notChecked: whether a risk is real; whether the rating reflects the actual exposure; whether an action has been carried out; risks that were never recorded.

pros: Flags a review date that has passed.
cons: Not checked: whether a risk is real; whether the rating reflects the actual exposure; whether an action has been carried out; risks that were never recorded.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-core-risk-register skill on the records for this review.
